headline: No API changes break the bot today; the ideas add a clock to every scalp, tag why you closed each trade, and tell you to wait one candle after a hard taker-driven spike.

ideas.title: Time stop: a clock on every scalp
ideas.why: Pick a hold limit before entry, e.g. 4 candles on 15m (1 hour). If neither stop nor target has hit, close it. /report lists trades held past the limit and what they made, so you see whether slow trades are where your losses grow.

ideas.title: Tag why you closed each trade
ideas.why: After each imported trade, one tap: Plan, Fear (early exit), FOMO entry, or Moved stop. /week shows P&L per tag. After ~30 trades you see in numbers what breaking your own rules costs, beyond revenge timing.

ideas.title: "Wait a candle" flag after a taker-driven spike
ideas.why: A 2026 study of 183 Binance pairs found 15-minute moves tend to partly reverse, most after aggressive taker buying or selling. Flag movers whose last 15m candle was big and mostly one-sided takers: wait for the next close before entering.
